facts.text: Snow left Cedar Pass (7,060 ft) and Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft) 41 to 43 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Cedar Pass
evidence.detail: left April 5; earlier seasons: May 22 (2023), May 18 (2024), May 14 (2025)

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: left April 28; earlier seasons: June 14 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 5 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Cedar Pass (7,060 ft) and Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft).

evidence.name: Cedar Pass
evidence.detail: 1.5 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 29.6 in (2023), 23.3 in (2024), 25.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: 6.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 45.8 in (2023), 37.0 in (2024), 45.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 5 and April 30, carried from the melt-out dates at Cedar Pass (7,060 ft) and Dismal Swamp (7,370 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Cedar Pass
evidence.detail: melted out April 5, 653 ft above the pass; points to February 26 to April 20

evidence.name: Dismal Swamp
evidence.detail: melted out April 28, 963 ft above the pass; points to March 13 to May 10
